title: GoogleDoc - Data API
description: Represents a link to a Google Document. This object is available in API version 14.0 and later.

Name.description: The name of the Google document.

Owner.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Update
Owner.description: The ID of the user who currently owns this Google Document. Default value is the user logged in to the API to perform the create.

ParentId.description: ID of the attachment's parent object. The following objects are supported as parents of Google documents: Account, Asset, Campaign, Case, Contact, Contract, Custom Object Behavior, Lead, Opportunity, Product2, and Solution.

Url.description: The URL of the Google document.

special_access_rules:
